content: Nioxoadipi Jesus oyajoi
Niɡ̶idiaaɡ̶idi Jesus igotedeloco nipodigi Galiléia. Aɡ̶idiaaɡ̶ite nipodigi Judéia, leeɡ̶odi niɡ̶ijoa lacilodi judeutedi digoida Judéia odoletibige moyeloadi.
Jiɡ̶ipegiteloco lalokegi judeutedi, anodita “Lalokegi nopecetiidi”.
Odaa niɡ̶ijo nioxoadipi Jesus moditalo, “Anotitice Galiléia, emii Judéia amaleeɡ̶aɡ̶a onadi niɡ̶ina anodiotibigaɡ̶adici niɡ̶inoa ɡ̶odoxiceɡ̶etedi anawiite.
Igaataɡ̶a niɡ̶ina ane yemaa me yeloɡ̶o, ayaɡ̶aditini niɡ̶ina loenatagi. Genaɡ̶a awiite niɡ̶inoa ane libinienaɡ̶a, odaa ele mikeenitiogi inatawece oko”.
Pida oteɡ̶exaaɡ̶aɡ̶a niɡ̶idi nioxoadipi aɡ̶oyiwaɡ̶adi.
Odaa jeɡ̶eetediogi Jesus, “Aniɡ̶icota limedi me jikee ane Ee. Pida akaamitiwaji boɡ̶okanicodaaɡ̶aca lakata noko yakadi memii.
Niɡ̶ina okotigi digoina iiɡ̶o aɡ̶ica leeɡ̶odi doɡ̶oyelataɡ̶adomitiwaji, pida Ee boɡ̶oyelatomi. Igaataɡ̶a jikeetiogi niɡ̶inoa loenataka ane beyagi.
Emiitiwaji miditaɡ̶a nalokegi. Ee baɡ̶aleedeɡ̶ejigo igaataɡ̶a aniɡ̶icota limedi me idinikee ane Ee”.
Joaniɡ̶idaa ligegitediogi, odaa jiɡ̶idiaaɡ̶itedice Galiléia.
Jesus igo miditaɡ̶a nalokegi
Igaanaɡ̶a leecawaanigi migotibeci niɡ̶ijo nioxoadipi miditaɡ̶a nalokegi, odaa Jesus jaɡ̶aɡ̶a igo. Pida dinaɡ̶aditedini migo, aɡ̶ica ane yowooɡ̶odi.
Icoa lacilodi judeutedi joɡ̶odoletibige Jesus miditaɡ̶a nalokegi. Modi, “Igamige diɡ̶etedigi?”

Ica lapo-nelegi miditaɡ̶a niɡ̶ijo nalokegi, eliodi oko oxatiniwace niɡ̶ina me notaɡ̶anaɡ̶a oyalaɡ̶atalo Jesus. Idi oko anodi, “Niɡ̶ijoa ɡ̶oneleegiwa doane mele”. Odaa idiaaɡ̶eledi modi, “Amitiɡ̶ica ica mele, mina ninaaletediniwace oko”.
Pida aɡ̶ica ane yalaɡ̶atalo me lodoe oko-nelegi, leeɡ̶odi odoitiogi niɡ̶idiwa lacilodi judeutedi.
Igaanaɡ̶a ixomaɡ̶atedijo liwigotigi niɡ̶ijoa nokododi me nalooɡ̶o, odaa jaɡ̶aɡ̶a icotedio Jesus, ja dakatediwece Aneotedoɡ̶oji liɡ̶eladi, odaa ja niiɡ̶axitediniwace oko.
Niɡ̶ijoa lacilodi judeutedi eliodi moyopo, modi, “Igaamee ina me yowooɡ̶odi inoatawece? Igaataɡ̶a niɡ̶inoa ɡ̶oniiɡ̶axinoɡ̶ododi aɡ̶ica doɡ̶oiiɡ̶axi”.
Naɡ̶a niniɡ̶odi Jesus, meetediogi, “Niɡ̶inoa ane jiiɡ̶axinaɡ̶atece aɡ̶emaɡ̶a yowooko, pida icoɡ̶otedibigimece miniwataɡ̶a Aneotedoɡ̶oji, ane idiiɡ̶e.
Nigica ane yemaa meo ane yemaa Aneotedoɡ̶oji, joaniɡ̶iniaa yowooɡ̶odi migewi me icoɡ̶otedibigimece miniwataɡ̶a Aneotedoɡ̶oji niɡ̶inoa iiɡ̶axinaɡ̶aneɡ̶eco, oɡ̶oa domige emaɡ̶a yowooko.
Niɡ̶ina ane diiɡ̶axinaɡ̶atece epaa lowooko, niɡ̶ini doletibige me dinikeenaɡ̶aneɡ̶e. Pida niɡ̶ina ane doletibige meo me yeloɡ̶o Aneotedoɡ̶oji, niɡ̶ini beɡ̶ewi, codaa me iɡ̶enaɡ̶a.
Moisés yajigotedaɡ̶awatiwaji liiɡ̶enatakaneɡ̶eco Aneotedoɡ̶oji. Pida aɡ̶ica niɡ̶ina akaamitiwaji aneyiwaɡ̶adi liiɡ̶enatakaneɡ̶eco. Igaataɡ̶a idioka limedi moleetibigetiwaji madeloati.”
Noɡ̶oniniɡ̶odi niɡ̶idi oko-nelegi, moditalo, “Niɡ̶ida makaami ejime dakatiwaɡ̶aji niwigo abeyaceɡ̶egi. Igaataɡ̶a aɡ̶ica ane doletibige me ɡ̶adeloati”.
Meetediogi Jesus, “Niɡ̶ijo me jao ɡ̶odoxiceɡ̶edi libinienigi, odaa akaamitawecetiwaji joɡ̶opoo.

Digawini! Niɡ̶ina me saabado akagititiwaji lolaadogo nigaanigawaanigi me ikeeni meledi ida aneetege Aneotedoɡ̶oji loiigi, leeɡ̶odi lajoinaɡ̶aneɡ̶egi Moisés. Codaa aniɡ̶ijaaɡ̶ijotace Moisés liiɡ̶enatakaneɡ̶egi, pida jotigide ɡ̶adaamipi maleediɡ̶icata Moisés naɡ̶akaaɡ̶ida me lakatigi.

Akagititiwaji nigaanigawaanigi lolaadogo niɡ̶ina me saabado, noko ane daɡ̶a domaɡ̶a yakadi mica ɡ̶abakedi, me iwitece lajoinaɡ̶aneɡ̶eco Moisés. Enice, igaamee ina me ɡ̶adelatomi, leeɡ̶odi me jicilatiditece niɡ̶ijo ɡ̶oneleegiwa ijoatawece libeyaceɡ̶eco me saabado?
Ikanitiwaji me ɡ̶adiɡ̶oati oko leeɡ̶odi anee mida moko, pida oleetibige ane iɡ̶enaɡ̶a codaa anewi niɡ̶ina mawini eledi oko anee.”
Niɡ̶ica aniniwa Jesus
Onica ica niɡ̶eladimigipitigi nigotaɡ̶a Jerusalém, anodi, “Niɡ̶idoa jiɡ̶idaaɡ̶idoa niɡ̶icoa ɡ̶oneleegiwa anodoletibige moyeloadi.

Pida digawini! Dotaɡ̶atedibece lodoe niɡ̶ina noiigi, niɡ̶inoa ɡ̶odacilodi aɡ̶ica mowote, aɡ̶ica ligegi doɡ̶odakapetege. Migoyowooɡ̶odi mewi niɡ̶idoa ɡ̶oneleegiwa niɡ̶idaaɡ̶idoa Icoa ane niiɡ̶e Aneotedoɡ̶oji meote ɡ̶odewiɡ̶a?

Pida Niɡ̶icoa ane niiɡ̶e Aneotedoɡ̶oji nigenagi, aɡ̶ica ane yowooɡ̶odi niɡ̶ica ane icoɡ̶otedicogi. Igaataɡ̶a baɡ̶a jowooɡ̶otaɡ̶a ane icoɡ̶otedicogi niɡ̶idoa ɡ̶oneleegiwa. (Odaa niɡ̶idoa ɡ̶oneleegiwa ayakadi daantiɡ̶idaaɡ̶idoa Niɡ̶icoa ane niiɡ̶e Aneotedoɡ̶oji.)”

Eɡ̶idaaɡ̶ee me diiɡ̶axinaɡ̶a Jesus catiwedi Aneotedoɡ̶oji liɡ̶eladi, ja yawice me dotaɡ̶a, mee, “Migewi madowooɡ̶otitiwaji, codaa migewi mowooɡ̶oti ane jicoɡ̶oticogi? Ajanagi daɡ̶a jibake emaɡ̶a inaɡ̶atetigi. Niɡ̶ijoa ane idiiɡ̶e ewi. Pida niɡ̶ida makaamitiwaji aɡ̶icoa mowooɡ̶oti.
Pida Ee baɡ̶a jowooɡ̶odi, igaataɡ̶a ida anejitege, codaa jeɡ̶epaa idimonya”.
Odaa joɡ̶odoletibige moniwilo Jesus, leeɡ̶odi niɡ̶ijoa lotaɡ̶a. Pida aɡ̶ica ane dibatalo, leeɡ̶odi aniɡ̶icota limedi me yeleo.

Eliodi oko niɡ̶ijo lapo-nelegi joɡ̶oyiwaɡ̶adi. Odaa modi, “Ajawienatakanaɡ̶a niɡ̶ina nigenagi Niɡ̶icoa ane niiɡ̶e Aneotedoɡ̶oji meote ɡ̶odewiɡ̶a, aɡ̶eote ɡ̶odoxiceɡ̶etedi ane naɡ̶axatelogo niɡ̶inoa aneote niɡ̶idoa ɡ̶oneleegiwa.”
Oiiɡ̶e icoa iodaɡ̶awadi moniwilo Jesus

Onateciɡ̶ijo niɡ̶ijo fariseutedi owajipata ligegi niɡ̶ijo lapo-nelegi moyalaɡ̶atalo Jesus, pida oxatiniwace. Joaniɡ̶idaa leeɡ̶odi niɡ̶ijo fariseutedi ijaaɡ̶ijo niɡ̶ijo anoiiɡ̶e sacerdotitedi moiiɡ̶e niodaɡ̶awadi me domoɡ̶odibatalo Jesus.
Odaa jeɡ̶eetediogi Jesus niɡ̶ijo oko, “Aleegi minaaɡ̶ejo makaamitaɡ̶atiwaji. Nigidiaaɡ̶idi jopiticogi miniwataɡ̶a Niɡ̶ijoa ane idiiɡ̶etedinicogi digoina iiɡ̶o.
Icota moleetibigijitiwaji, pida apinitibigiji aɡ̶adakati, igaataɡ̶a aɡ̶akati deɡ̶emiitiwaji ane jiiticogi”.

Odaa modi niɡ̶ijo lacilodi judeutedi, “Igamige diitedicogi ina nige daɡ̶adiaaɡ̶icoa me jakataɡ̶a? Domige igo miditaɡ̶a ɡ̶odoiigi judeutedi ane idei midiwataɡ̶a nigotadi noiigi greego? Oɡ̶oa, mige igo me niiɡ̶axitediniwace idi ane daɡ̶a ɡ̶odoiigi?
Ajowooɡ̶otaɡ̶a niɡ̶ica ane diitigilo niɡ̶ijoa lotaɡ̶a niɡ̶ijo neɡ̶eetedoɡ̶owa, ‘Oleetibigijitiwaji, pida aɡ̶aleeɡ̶ee madakati, apinitibigiji leeɡ̶odi aɡ̶akati deɡ̶emiitiwaji ane jiiticogi’.”
Lacilotibige ninyoɡ̶odi aneo ɡ̶odewiɡ̶a

Niɡ̶ijo owidijegi noko me nalooɡ̶o, jiɡ̶ijaaɡ̶ijo niɡ̶ica noko ane daɡ̶axa me ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi. Odaa niɡ̶ijo noko dabiditedini Jesus, ja yawice me dotaɡ̶a, mee, “Nigica ane yeloadi ecibi, anagi meetaɡ̶a, acipe!
Mee Aneotedoɡ̶oji lotaɡ̶anaɡ̶axi, ‘Laaleɡ̶ena niɡ̶ina oko ane idadiwaɡ̶adi liciagi niɡ̶ina lacilotibige ninyoɡ̶odi. Latoaɡ̶egi ninyoɡ̶odi aneo ɡ̶odewiɡ̶a icoɡ̶otiwece laaleɡ̶ena’”.

Jesus eeteta Liwigo Aneotedoɡ̶oji modibatege niɡ̶ina anoyiwaɡ̶adi. Pida aniɡ̶ica doɡ̶odibatege Liwigo Aneotedoɡ̶oji, igaataɡ̶a Aneotedoɡ̶oji aneɡ̶eote Jesus me daɡ̶axa me ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi, leeɡ̶odi anaɡ̶a yeleo codaa anaɡ̶a yewiɡ̶atace.
Dawalacetiwage oko
Igaanaɡ̶a owajipatalo lotaɡ̶a Jesus niɡ̶ijo noiigi-nelegi, eliodi oko modi, “Dicewi niɡ̶idoa ɡ̶oneleegiwa niɡ̶idaaɡ̶idoa niɡ̶icoa ane yeloɡ̶oditedibece lowooko Aneotedoɡ̶oji”.
Pida idi ica eledi oko anodi, “Jiɡ̶idaaɡ̶idoa Niɡ̶icoa ane niiɡ̶e Aneotedoɡ̶oji meote ɡ̶odewiɡ̶a”. Pida ica eledi oko modi, “Niɡ̶icoa ane niiɡ̶e Aneotedoɡ̶oji aicoɡ̶otedicogi nipodigi Galiléia.

Igaataɡ̶a mee Aneotedoɡ̶oji lotaɡ̶anaɡ̶axi, ‘Niɡ̶icoa ane niiɡ̶e Aneotedoɡ̶oji meote ɡ̶odewiɡ̶a ida aneetetege licoɡ̶egi Davi, codaa idiaaɡ̶aɡ̶a lanikadi manitaɡ̶a nigotakawaana Belém, ane liɡ̶eladi Davi’”.
Odaa niɡ̶ijo noiigi-nelegi ja dawalacetiwage leeɡ̶odi Jesus.
Odaa idi ica anodoletibige moniwilo, pida aɡ̶ica ane dibatalo.
Lacilodi judeutedi aɡ̶eniwaɡ̶atakanaɡ̶a

Odaa niɡ̶ijoa iodaɡ̶awadi anoiiɡ̶e ja dopiticogi minitaɡ̶a niɡ̶ijo lapo fariseutedi ijaaɡ̶ijo niɡ̶ijo anoiiɡ̶e sacerdotitedi. Odaa joɡ̶onigetiniwace niɡ̶idiwa iodaɡ̶awadi, moditiogi, “Igaamee ina me diɡ̶icoateda manadeegitetiwaji?”
Noɡ̶oigidi, moditiogi, “Aniɡ̶ica daɡ̶a jinataɡ̶a ane dotaɡ̶a liciagi niɡ̶ijoa ɡ̶oneleegiwa me dotaɡ̶a”.
Odaa niɡ̶ijoa fariseutedi moditiogi niɡ̶ijoa iodaɡ̶awadi, “Naɡ̶aɡ̶a etiɡ̶adinaalenitiwaji?
Aɡ̶ica aneyiwaɡ̶adi niɡ̶ijoa ɡ̶oneleegiwa niɡ̶inoa lacilodi judeutedi, oteɡ̶exaaɡ̶aɡ̶a niɡ̶idiwa fariseutedi.
Pida niɡ̶idi noiigi aɡ̶oyowooɡ̶odi ɡ̶onajoinaɡ̶aneɡ̶eco ane najigotedoɡ̶owa Moisés, odaa Aneotedoɡ̶oji icota me iloikatidi”.
Onijoteci fariseu ane liboonaɡ̶adi Nicodemus, niɡ̶ijo ane igo dinotaɡ̶aneɡ̶etege Jesus niɡ̶ijo enoale, meetiogi,
“Ǥonajoinaɡ̶aneɡ̶eco anikatoɡ̶odici daɡ̶a jiiɡ̶enatakanaɡ̶a motacidetibigo okanicodaaɡ̶ica ɡ̶oneleegiwa nige doɡ̶odoejegi me jajipaaɡ̶ata, codaa nige daɡ̶a jowooɡ̶otaɡ̶a ane loenatagi”.

Noɡ̶oniniɡ̶odi, modita, “Domige akaami eledi elatibige nipodigi Galiléia? Awiniteloco Aneotedoɡ̶oji lotaɡ̶anaɡ̶axi, odaa joɡ̶owooɡ̶oti me diɡ̶ica ane yeloɡ̶oditedibece Aneotedoɡ̶oji lowooko ane icoɡ̶oticogi nipodigi Galiléia.”
Odaa niɡ̶idiaaɡ̶idi ijotawece niɡ̶ijo oko joɡ̶opiticogi niɡ̶inoa liɡ̶elatedi.
